name: @projexlight/sdk-consent
summary: Explicit-consent receipt ledger for ProjexCloud: define data-processing Purposes once, grant per-subject Receipts referencing them, check at runtime before any purpose-scoped read/write, and revoke triggers a sdk-data-rights fan-out. Supports the offline-grant queue (in-person + paper-signed channels reconciled when the device reconnects) and signed export for DSAR fulfillment. Mandatory upstream of any PII processing in healthcare and GDPR-scoped tenants.

endpoints.description: Register a data-processing Purpose. Required before any Receipt can reference it.
Grant a new Receipt for (subject, purpose). Carries channel (portal / in-person / paper-signed / voice-recorded).
Revoke a receipt. Emits consent.receipt.revoked.v1 → sdk-data-rights starts the erasure fan-out.
Runtime gate: does (subject, purpose) have an active, non-expired Receipt? Used by every PII-touching SDK on the hot path.
Export every Receipt for a subject (DSAR Art-15).

events.name: consent.purpose.registered.v1
events.description: New processing-purpose defined for a tenant.

events.name: consent.receipt.granted.v1
events.description: Subject granted consent for a purpose. Carries channel + expires_at.

events.name: consent.receipt.revoked.v1
events.description: Receipt revoked. Downstream sdk-data-rights consumes this to start the erasure fan-out.

events.name: consent.check.denied.v1
events.description: Runtime check returned false; useful for observability ('are we asking for purposes nobody consented to?').

events.name: consent.export.delivered.v1
events.description: DSAR-style export bundle delivered to the requesting subject.

models.description: Processing-purpose definition: tenant_id, name, description, legal_basis, default_expiry_days.
Per-(subject, purpose) receipt: granted_at, expires_at, channel, version_of_purpose_text.
In-person / paper-signed grants captured on a device offline; reconciled to receipts on reconnect.

hooks.name: registerPurpose
hooks.description: Idempotent on (tenant_id, name). Required before any Receipt can reference the purpose.

hooks.name: grantConsent
hooks.description: Service-layer grant. Auto-fills expires_at from purpose.default_expiry_days if not provided.

hooks.name: checkConsent
hooks.description: Runtime hot-path gate. Pulls cached Receipt + checks not-expired + not-revoked. Sub-ms when warm.

hooks.name: revokeConsent
hooks.description: Revoke + emit. The actual erasure happens via sdk-data-rights consuming the event.

scenarios.title: Tenant admin registers a processing purpose
scenarios.when_to_use: Required setup. Tenants must declare every purpose for which they hold PII before they can collect a Receipt for it.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns purpose_id. Emits consent.purpose.registered.v1. Now eligible to be referenced by Receipts.

scenarios.title: Subject grants consent via the portal checkbox
scenarios.when_to_use: Customer signs up + ticks 'I consent to marketing emails'. We persist a Receipt referencing the purpose.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns receipt_id + expires_at. Emits consent.receipt.granted.v1. Cached in Redis so the next checkConsent is sub-ms.

scenarios.title: PII-touching SDK gates a write on consent check
scenarios.when_to_use: Any SDK about to write or read PII for a purpose. Refusal here means the operation is blocked at the source.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns boolean. On false, the caller MUST refuse the operation. Emits consent.check.denied.v1 on false so an admin can spot 'we're processing for purposes no one consented to'.

scenarios.title: Right-to-be-forgotten — revoke receipt + fan-out erasure
scenarios.when_to_use: Customer unsubscribes / files a DSAR. Revocation triggers sdk-data-rights to scrub every store keyed by that subject for that purpose.
scenarios.example_code:
import { revokeConsent } from '@projexlight/sdk-consent';
await revokeConsent({ receipt_id, requested_by_persona_id });
scenarios.expected_outcome: Receipt marked revoked. Emits consent.receipt.revoked.v1. sdk-data-rights' worker picks it up + fans out deletion. Customer-visible status in the tenant-admin Consent page transitions to 'erasing → erased'.

scenarios.title: Paper-signed consent captured offline by a field rep
scenarios.when_to_use: Field tech captures a paper consent in a low-connectivity environment; the offline queue holds it; on reconnect we reconcile to a real Receipt.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Subject ends up with a normal Receipt; the only differentiator vs. a portal-checkbox grant is the channel field. Conflict resolution on dup subject+purpose: keep the earlier granted_at, append the later as a renewal.

compliance_posture.notes: Article 7(3) GDPR: withdrawal must be as easy as grant — revokeConsent is one call, no manager approval needed. HIPAA 164.508 authorization fields (purpose, expiration, signature) all captured in the Receipt + Purpose pair. Receipts are append-only — revocation writes a separate row, never edits the grant.

pricing_skus.unit_description: per check call (most are cache hits; cache misses billed at a higher rate)
per revocation (free; we want revocation to be friction-free)
